containers.name: Mare Pacificum
containers.zone_count_reason: 23: the Tasman Basin Zone is added because the owner put the Tasman Sea at sea (O7, 24 Oct), and the North and South Zealandia Zones because the owner put a continental fragment's submerged plateaus at sea (25 Oct); New Zealand's land and shelf part the two. Folding the Juan de Fuca Zone into the Northeast Pacific Basin Zone, the design's way down one, is the owner's to take.
